ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, the general partner, all limited partners holding 25% or more, and senior managers against: (i) UN Security Council Consolidated Lists; (ii) UK HM Treasury OFSI consolidated sanctions list (extended to Bermuda as a British Overseas Territory); (iii) US OFAC SDN list, given USD-settled payment rails via Stripe/Paddle and US correspondent banking; (iv) EU consolidated financial sanctions list for EUR settlement; and (v) Bermuda FIA and BMA regulatory notices. PEP detection applies the Wolfsberg Group standard: enhanced due diligence for any person who holds or has held within the preceding 12 months a prominent public function, their family members, and known close associates. Any PEP or sanctions hit automatically escalates to the AML Compliance Officer of the Bermuda registered agent and the general partner, with mandatory source-of-wealth verification and senior-management approval. The AI avatar video SaaS business is assessed as Standard, Low-Risk under the 2008 AML Regulations and FIA guidance for financial institutions and DNFBPs; no statutory financial services license is required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies and Partnerships Registry of Bermuda (Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance) via the Government of Bermuda BERMUDABusiness e-services portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official language of the registry is English. The proposed name must be rendered in Latin (Roman) script; Chinese or other non-Roman transliterations are not accepted on the certificate of registration. For an Exempted Limited Partnership, the name must end with 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviation 'L.P.' in accordance with section 5 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name or to a third party's registered trademark where use would mislead the public.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File Form NR (Name Reservation) with the Registrar of Companies at a statutory fee of BMD 50; the reservation is valid for 30 days and may be extended once for a further 30 days (maximum 60 days) upon payment of an additional administrative fee. In the event of provisional refusal, the Registrar issues a written refusal memorandum stating the statutory grounds. Appeal procedure: (1) within 14 calendar days of the date of the refusal memorandum, submit a written request for reconsideration to the Registrar of Companies, attaching trademark searches, evidence of consent where applicable, and a legal submission distinguishing the proposed name from any cited conflicting name; (2) if the Registrar affirms the refusal, file a request for ministerial review with the Minister of Finance under section 25(8) of the Companies Act 1981, applied by analogy to exempted partnerships; (3) as a final remedy, institute judicial review proceedings in the Supreme Court of Bermuda within 3 months of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A standalone virtual office with mail-forwarding only and no physical presence in Bermuda is not compliant; every exempted partnership must maintain a registered office address in Bermuda under section 19 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992, and a post-office box is not acceptable. The permissible and customary model for a pure AIGC SaaS exporter is to use the physical office address of a licensed corporate services provider in Bermuda as the registered office and administrative seat, achieving a 'virtual presence' structure while satisfying legal substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 5% annualized likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered office of a standard, low-risk, non-licensed SaaS entity. The Bermuda registered agent (approved corporate services provider) carries a materially higher inspection probability of approximately 25–35% within a 3-year AML inspection cycle conducted by the Registrar of Companies or the BMA, including verification of client due-diligence files and registered office records.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (Bermuda), as amended, ss. 4-9 (registration and declaration), s. 25 (annual return), s. 33 (general partner liability); supplemented by the Partnership Act 1902.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Ministry of Finance), Registered Companies and Partnerships Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Declaration of Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1) filed with the Registrar of Companies, Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; capital commitments are fixed solely by the exempted limited partnership agreement. The partnership must maintain a registered office and a resident representative in Bermuda, and at least one general partner must be appointed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE GENERAL PARTNER OF [•] EXEMPTED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, adopted [date] pursuant to the partnership agreement and the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992. RESOLVED: (1) the Declaration of Limited Partnership be executed and filed with the Registrar of Companies, Bermuda; (2) the registered office be at [address], Hamilton, Bermuda; (3) [•] Limited be appointed general partner with exclusive management authority; (4) partnership interests be allotted per Schedule A; (5) a bank account be opened at [•] Bank; (6) [•] be appointed AML/ATF compliance officer; and (7) these resolutions take effect upon registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance request through the Registry's online portal or in person. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company or limited partnership and must end with 'L.P.' or 'Limited Partnership'. Use the expedited clearance service where same-day confirmation is required.
required_dossiers: Screenshot or list of proposed name variants
Consent letter from the intended resident representative (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or reserved for another entity, file a written objection with the Registrar, submit an amended name variant, and resubmit the clearance application without additional statutory fees within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Partnership Agreement and Appointment of General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered legal counsel / licensed corporate service provider (no government filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the exempted limited partnership agreement defining capital contributions, profit-sharing, management rights, and restrictions on limited partners. Appoint the general partner (usually a Bermuda exempted company or a non-resident entity with a Bermuda resident representative) and obtain the written consent to act of the general partner.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing of the corporate general partner (if any)
Consent to act of the general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the general partner's fitness or the agreement's provisions, amend the agreement by supplemental deed and re-execute before filing; no public disclosure of the internal agreement is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Declaration of Limited Partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed Declaration of Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1) with the Registry, setting out the partnership name, registered office address, general partner particulars, nature of business, and term. Pay the official registration fee of USD 1,780 by bank draft or approved electronic payment.
required_dossiers: Signed Declaration of Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1)
Consent to act of each general partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, correct the specified particulars and file an amended declaration under s. 9 of the Exempted Partnerships Act within the prescribed response period; the Certificate of Registration is issued upon full compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Registration, BMA Exchange Control Consent, and AML/ATF Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies; Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Registration. Apply to the BMA for non-resident status consent under the Exchange Control Act 1972, confirming the partnership is owned and controlled outside Bermuda. Register the partnership's AML/ATF compliance framework under the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 if any relevant financial business is conducted in Bermuda; otherwise document the exemption in the general partner's compliance file.
required_dossiers: AML/ATF risk assessment and procedures manual
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BMA consent is delayed or conditionally granted, provide supplemental information on ownership and source of funds; if the AML/ATF programme is deemed inadequate, revise the manual and resubmit through the registered agent within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Economic Substance Declaration, Tax Registration, and Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner; Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Unit); licensed Bermuda bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual Economic Substance Declaration confirming that the AI avatar video generation SaaS activity is executed outside Bermuda and is therefore a non-relevant activity. Register for payroll tax and social insurance with the Office of the Tax Commissioner only if employee presence in Bermuda is established. Open the partnership's operating bank account at a licensed Bermuda bank and link the Stripe/Paddle merchant settlement rails to the entity's payouts.
required_dossiers: Confirmation of tax status / non-resident status
Bank KYC package and source-of-funds evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Economic Substance Unit classifies the activity as relevant, demonstrate core income-generating activities outside Bermuda with factual documentation; if the Tax Commissioner issues an assessment, file a formal objection and appeal under the applicable tax legislation within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for pure-software AIGC operations; the Department of Planning (Bermuda) regulates any physical premises that the partnership may later occupy in Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required for AI Avatar Video Generation SaaS. A Business Licence under the Business Licence Act 2014 is required only if the ELP carries on business in or from Bermuda; a fully non-resident ELP with no Bermuda place of business is outside the licensing net.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Environmental Quality Section, Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the software-as-a-service activity has no physical infrastructure and does not trigger a listed project threshold under the Planning Act 1982; no EIA report or environmental registration is required for a virtual AIGC operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for virtual operations. Should a physical office or server room be established, all wastewater discharge must comply with the Clean Water Act 1972 standards, electronic waste must be routed through the Solid Waste Management Regulations 2014, and no point-source VOC emissions are permitted without an environmental permit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety or occupational clearance applies to a fully virtual entity with no Bermuda premises. If physical premises are later acquired, the occupier must obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service, an electrical certificate of compliance, a structural Certificate of Compliance from the Department of Planning, and an Occupational Safety and Health clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982 before occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Tax Administration (Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance); portal: https://www.gov.bm/tax-information (electronic filing via Government of Bermuda e-Tax system)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities, including Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnerships, are not subject to a general income tax registration regime. Any entity with Bermuda-sourced payroll or customs activity must register under the Payroll Tax Act and Customs Act via the e-Tax portal, obtaining a Payroll Tax Account Number and a Customs Broker/Importer Code. ELPs with no Bermuda payroll or imports enjoy no registration duty. For indirect tax purposes, apply to the Tax Commissioner for a Bermuda Tax Reference Number (BTRN) if required to account for customs duties or payroll tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Bermuda law; partnership classification follows the Exempted Partnerships Act and Income Tax (Bermuda) exemption orders. Hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable as there is no corporate income tax; however, an ELP may apply for a specific exemption certificate under the Exempted Partnerships Act and may elect foreign-currency functional status for reporting to the Bermuda Monetary Authority.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Customs Duties (Import Tariff); no VAT/GST on sales of services. Bermuda has no general sales tax, VAT, or gross receipts tax on services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None for VAT-equivalent; Customs import registration is required for any entity importing goods regardless of value. Payroll tax registration is required only when Bermuda-sourced payroll exceeds BMD 0 (first BMD 500,000 p.a. exempt for qualifying entities).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate for digital services; e-Tax and Bermuda Customs Automated Commercial Environment (CACE) support electronic declarations. No API-based VAT clearance or digital stamping regime applies to AIGC SaaS services.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable because Bermuda imposes no VAT/GST on services; cross-border SaaS and AI video generation services are outside the scope of Bermuda indirect tax. Export goods are not subject to Bermuda export duty, and services supplied to overseas customers carry no Bermuda tax to zero-rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (if goods exported from Bermuda)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or banking evidence of foreign currency receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating refund or clawback regime exists in Bermuda. General anti-avoidance provisions under the Tax Commissioner Act permit penalties up to 100% of underpaid tax plus interest for misdeclaration in customs or payroll filings; fraudulent customs declarations attract fines up to BMD 10,000 and/or imprisonment. Export-related documents must be retained 6 years for Customs audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), established under the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969, is the central bank, currency issuing authority, exchange control administrator and bank supervisor for Bermuda, an internally self-governing British Overseas Territory with the United Kingdom (GB) as the sovereign parent state. The BMA administers the Exchange Control Act 1972 and licenses deposit-taking institutions under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999; it also operates the virtual currency/Digital Asset Business licensing framework where applicable, although the AI avatar SaaS model does not trigger that regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1 BMD : 1 USD, and US Dollars circulate as parallel legal tender, eliminating currency mismatch risk for USD-denominated AI SaaS revenues. Full current and capital account convertibility applies to a properly designated non-resident exempted limited partnership: the BMA grants a non-resident designation at formation through the registered agent, which carries general exchange control permission for unlimited foreign currency bank accounts, unrestricted inward/outward capital and profit flows, and free conversion of BMD into any external currency without prior BMA approval. Profit remittance hurdles are nil at Bermuda level: Bermuda levies no income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax on dividends/interest/royalties, or distribution restrictions; the ELP is fiscally transparent and profits flow to partners directly. The only practical friction is documentary—each distribution above USD 100,000 requires a GP distribution resolution, an updated allocation/register schedule, and a source-of-funds trail acceptable to the paying bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory baseline: the Exchange Control Act 1972 requires Bermuda-resident exporters to receive export proceeds through an authorised bank within 6 months of the date of export; however, a non-resident designated exempted partnership is carved out of the resident surrender regime. Mandatory conversion ratio for the ELP: 0% — proceeds of AI software and video-generation services collected via Stripe/Paddle as Merchant of Record may be retained 100% in USD, BMD, GBP or EUR in any jurisdiction, with no obligation to convert to BMD or to repatriate to Bermuda. Maintenance condition: the BMA non-resident designation must be kept current through the Bermuda registered agent, and the bank's standing instructions must show the designation certificate; if the ELP were re-characterised as Bermuda-resident, the 6-month realisation and conversion rules could apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.fx_regime_additional_notes: Bermuda imposes no exchange controls on non-resident entities for trade-related payments, dividend distributions, capital repayment, or treasury hedging. BMD and USD clearing is effectively fungible; BMD payments settle through the Bermuda Automated Clearing House and USD payments settle via Fedwire/CHIPS through New York correspondents. All inward and outward wires are subject to SWIFT screening against OFAC/UN/EU/UK sanctions lists as applied by the Bermuda banks and their correspondents.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited (Butterfield)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Corporate Operating Account (SaaS settlement) plus segregated USD Capital Escrow / Client Asset Account for partner contributions
USD Business Current Account (operational) and USD Reserve/Escrow Account; subject to HSBC Group de-risking assessment and beneficial ownership review
USD Business Chequing Account and USD Escrow / Term Deposit sweeps for liquidity buffer
Wholesale Treasury Settlement Account (USD) with high minimum relationship balance; appropriate for FX hedging and treasury rather than daily SaaS operating flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: MEDIUM. Legal feasibility is affirmative: (a) the non-resident exchange-control designation removes any BMA consent requirement for the ELP to hold foreign-denominated accounts at an overseas Electronic Money Institution; (b) no Bermuda banking licence is triggered where the EMI itself is licensed in its home state (e.g., FCA e-money licence for Wise or Revolut Business, or equivalent EU/APAC licences); (c) the ELP may lawfully receive SaaS payouts through an EMI. Practical constraints: EMIs consistently risk-tier British Overseas Territory entities and may decline under internal offshore-shell policies; where accepted, onboarding requires the Certificate of Exempted Partnership, registered partnership agreement, GP register of directors, source of capital evidence and proof of genuine SaaS activity; e-money balances are safeguarded but uninsured (no FSCS or Bermuda deposit insurance), so EMIs should hold only low-float operating balances. Recommended deployment: Wise Business multi-currency accounts for GBP/EUR vendor payments and staff reimbursements under USD 25,000 per month; Airwallex or Nium only as backup receiving rails; the Capital Escrow Account and strategic operating reserve must remain at a Bermuda Tier-1 licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance in Hamilton is not mandatory for the full partner population, but a hybrid CDD standard applies: (1) the licensed Bermuda registered agent must submit a professional introduction letter with certified copies of the Declaration of Exempted Partnership, Certificate of Exempted Partnership, registered partnership agreement and the current beneficial ownership filing; (2) every director of the corporate General Partner must provide notarised/certified passports, residential address proof, PEP/sanctions attestations and source of wealth statements; (3) at least one authorised signatory must complete a live video interview—Butterfield and Clarien accept Zoom-based liveness verification, while HSBC Bermuda retains discretion to require a physical interview for PEP signatories or whenever an ultimate beneficial owner resides in a high-risk jurisdiction; (4) if the GP is a BVI/Cayman exempted company, a Certificate of Good Standing and a bankers' reference from the GP's existing UK/EU bank are required; (5) limited partners need not appear provided their capital contributions are documented and they hold no signing authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exempted partnership with multi-layer offshore ownership (nominee limited partners, non-resident corporate GP in a second offshore centre) triggering Bermuda AML/ATF shell-risk typologies and BMA consolidated supervision scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defence bundle: (1) Declaration of Exempted Partnership and Certificate of Exempted Partnership issued by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies; (2) current Register of Partners and executed partnership agreement showing legal names, percentages, capital contribution schedule and economic purpose of each LP; (3) Beneficial Ownership declaration filed with the BMA; (4) notarised passports and address proofs for every LP above 10% and every GP director; (5) source-of-wealth letters with bank statements for each contributing partner; (6) Certificate of Good Standing and directors register for the corporate GP; (7) professional reference from the Bermuda registered agent confirming operational activity; (8) 12-month business plan and financial model evidencing an operating AI video SaaS with payroll, cloud costs and signed customer pipeline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible digital services and royalty-like SaaS income without conventional physical trade documents, raising false AML flags under high-risk IP/royalties typologies and US/EU/UK sanctions screening of data flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defence bundle: (1) executed Master SaaS Subscription Agreement, clickwrap EULA and data processing agreement with at least three anchor customers; (2) commercial invoices referencing ISIC 6201 / NAICS 511210, tax points and payment terms; (3) 12 months of Merchant of Record settlement reports from Stripe/Paddle cross-matched invoice-by-invoice to inbound USD sweeps; (4) service agreements with UK/EU/US cloud compute vendors evidencing genuine subcontract costs and headcount; (5) SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 certificate and UK GDPR data flow map demonstrating substantive digital operations; (6) partnership meeting minutes approving pricing, licensing and transfer policy; (7) an audit firm's letter confirming no intangible/licence migration and adequate substance in Bermuda.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of Exempted Partnership and Annual Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (submitted through the Bermuda registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January for the preceding calendar year; filing window opens 1 January.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of 10% of the annual fee applies after 31 January; unpaid arrears for more than 12 months may result in administrative strike-off of the ELP, loss of good-standing status, and reinstatement only by Supreme Court order with full settlement of arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Economic Substance Division (electronic filing via the Bermuda Economic Substance portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, due by 30 June each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the ES declaration attracts an administrative fine of up to BMD 10,000 (approximately USD 10,000); continuing default accrues daily penalties of BMD 1,000 and may result in material non-compliance status affecting the ELP's Certificate of Compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register Update and Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Beneficial Ownership Secure Search System (filed by the registered agent under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2018)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any change in beneficial ownership must be recorded within 30 days of the triggering event; the registered agent conducts an annual KYC confirmation at calendar year-end, aligned with the annual return filing by 31 January.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-maintenance of the UBO register or failure to supply beneficial ownership information on request: fine up to BMD 25,000 (approximately USD 25,000), continuing daily default penalty of BMD 1,000, and possible personal liability for responsible general partner officers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a Bermuda Exempted Partnership unless it is a BMA-supervised institution (banking, insurance, investment fund, or digital asset business) or its Limited Partnership Agreement expressly mandates an audit. The target AIGC video synthesis and virtual avatar software activity (ISIC 6201, NAICS 511210) is not a BMA-supervised activity and is not an Economic Substance 'relevant activity'; therefore no statutory audit is required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda prescribes no local GAAP for exempted partnerships. The ELP must maintain accounting records sufficient to explain its transactions and to disclose its financial position with reasonable accuracy. Financial statements are typically prepared under IFRS or US GAAP as elected in the Limited Partnership Agreement; such statements need not be filed with or publicly disclosed to the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP must identify every individual who holds at least 25% of partnership capital, profits, or voting rights, or who otherwise exercises ultimate control over the partnership. The registered agent collects and verifies UBO particulars at formation, performs an annual KYC refresh, and updates the central BO register within 30 days of any transfer of partnership interests or change in control. The Bermuda BO registry is not publicly searchable; access is restricted to the Registrar, the Bermuda Monetary Authority, and competent authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of General and Limited Partners (names, addresses, jurisdictions, and contributions)
Register of Capital Contributions and Profit-Share Allocations
Register of Powers of Attorney and Partner Consents
Minute Book and Resolutions of the General Partner
Registered Office and Registered Agent Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 3,000 - 5,500 per year (Bermuda registered office, licensed registered agent, annual return filing, and UBO compliance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 9,000 - 20,000 (voluntary IFRS audit only; not statutorily required for this non-supervised, non-financial-services ELP)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% general corporate income tax for out-of-scope Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnerships; 15% mandatory rate under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 for Bermuda constituent entities of MNE groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750 million in at least two of the four preceding fiscal years (GloBE/QDMTT-aligned).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions for ELPs. In-scope CIT filers benefit from the OECD Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE): 5% carve-out on eligible payroll costs and 5% on eligible tangible asset carrying values (rising to 10% in later years). ELP profit distributions are exempt from Bermuda income tax. Tax assurance certificates shelter qualifying out-of-scope entities from future taxes to 2050. Net CIT loss utilisation under the CIT Act is aligned to the GloBE excess-profit computation; outside CIT scope, loss relief is irrelevant because no Bermuda tax is charged on an out-of-scope ELP.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return (CIT Return) under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, filed electronically through the Bermuda Tax Commission e-filing portal administered by the Office of the Tax Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 months after the fiscal year-end; 18 months for the first fiscal year beginning on or after 1 January 2025. Final CIT/QDMTT payment is due on the filing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: MNE group identification, jurisdiction summary, and in-scope/out-of-scope revenue threshold confirmation (EUR 750M consolidated revenue in 2 of prior 4 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the ultimate parent entity jurisdiction, GloBE registration reference, and UK parent details; the ELP files for the Bermuda jurisdiction on behalf of its look-through partners; non-resident partners are not separate filers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal-year net GloBE income or loss attributable to the Bermuda ELP, applying the partnership look-through allocation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report each partner's allocable share in the supporting schedule; the ELP is tax-transparent, so the return records the aggregated Bermuda jurisdictional position, not a partnership-level tax charge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE) computation: eligible payroll costs and eligible tangible asset carrying values located in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach payroll and fixed-asset schedules; exclude costs recharged to the UK parent; ensure employees physically work in Bermuda and assets are not merely invoiced to Bermuda.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net CIT loss carryforward utilised in the current fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach contemporaneous loss schedules and tax-basis reconciliations; the claim must match the GloBE income computation and prior-year filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted jurisdictional income, Excess Profit after loss offsets, and Top-up Tax percentage determination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify the 15% top-up rate; compute the Bermuda QDMTT so that the Bermuda tax is collected locally ahead of the UK Multinational Top-up Tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT/QDMTT liability, payments made, and balance due or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm zero balance where SBIE and losses fully eliminate the liability; retain working papers for 7 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 10% of the CIT liability, plus an additional 10% for each further 6-month period of default; late-payment interest at the statutory rate; deliberate understatement triggers a civil penalty of up to 100% of underpaid tax and criminal fines up to BMD 250,000 on conviction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Economic Substance Declaration (Bermuda ESR Annual Declaration), filed electronically via the official ESR e-portal administered by the Bermuda Economic Substance Commission and the Registrar of Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months after the ELP's financial year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity particulars, registration number, financial year-end, registered office, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete with ELP legal entity identifier; name the UK corporate general partner and confirm the registered office is a physical Bermuda address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity classification: IP business, provision of services, distribution and service centre, or No Relevant Activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify the AI avatar video generation business as IP business only if the ELP holds and exploits the software IP and derives royalty-like income; a genuine SaaS execution operation with development and support performed abroad should declare No Relevant Activity with full supporting evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from relevant activities in Bermuda and from external sources; jurisdiction of income origin.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate income using arm's-length transfer pricing; cross-border transactions with the UK affiliate must be documented and consistent with Box 2 of the CIT Return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance indicators: management and direction in Bermuda, physical premises, full-time employees or partners, expenditure levels, and core income-generating activities performed in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach board or partner meeting minutes held in Bermuda, payroll records, lease agreements, and bank statements; a passive IP-holding ELP without local substance fails the core income-generating activity test.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Default declaration penalty up to BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per day for continued non-compliance; on conviction, fines up to BMD 250,000; serious or repeated failures result in loss of tax assurance status, publication of the non-compliant entity, and striking-off from the Bermuda Registrar.
